title: Governed Measure Registry
description: Schema for the governed-measure registry DATA artifact (measure-registry.json). Validated at load so a malformed registry FAILS CLOSED (OODS-V132) instead of silently degrading to an empty Map. This schema file is SKIP-LISTED from Generator A (NON_SCHEMA_DATA_FILES in schemas-tools/generate-types.ts) so it never emits a generated type that would collide with the hand-written MeasureEntry interface.

schemaVersion.description: Registry artifact version (independent of the dashboard-spec schemaVersion).

measures.description: Map of governed-measure reference (the value of KpiPanel.measureRef) to its compute inputs + governance metadata. Keys are namespaced under 'gm.'.

entityField.description: The dataset column the measure aggregates (overrides KpiPanel.field).

aggregate.description: The aggregate (overrides KpiPanel.aggregate). Mirrors the KpiPanel aggregate set (dashboard.types.ts:327).

measureRole.description: Governance classifier (e.g. 'metric' | 'dimension') — provenance only, NOT additivity.

additive.description: Whether the measure is additive across rows. Absent === true (back-compat). When false, a `sum` rollup is BLOCKED at the resolver boundary with OODS-V133 (a summed ratio/price is meaningless).

expectedGrain.description: Optional declared time-grain. When set AND resolveMeasures=true, the panel's actual period data (its periodField cells) is validated against this grain at resolve time: the finest observed granularity must equal expectedGrain, else the panel is routed through onPanelError as OODS-V138. Mirrors the analysis/temporal.ts TemporalGranularity members. ABSENT = no grain check (back-compat; the 5 s117/s118 entries stay unseeded so faostat-e2e/fidelity goldens are 0-diff).

defaultComparison.description: Author-overridable default KPI comparison (filled only when the panel omits comparison).

defaultThreshold.description: Author-overridable default KPI threshold (filled only when the panel omits threshold).
